_comment: Copy to ~/.config/pnk-sculpt/config.json and fill in your own values.
It lives outside this repo on purpose: hostnames and monitor ids are
site-specific and this repo is public.
vram_guard is optional. Include it only if the GPU is normally occupied
by something you need to stop first, such as a resident language model.
Omit it entirely on a machine with a free GPU.

_monitors_comment: Uptime-monitor ids to pause before a run and resume after.
trellis.py does NOT touch these: pause them yourself through your
monitoring tool, because a script that silences alerts and then dies

_key_command_comment: A shell command whose stdout is the key, e.g. a secret-manager fetch.
genref.py captures it and never prints it. Do not put the key itself
